notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Selvala with power 8 or greater.
description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {4}{G}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
